name: NJM2043 / NJM2043DD (New JRC low-noise dual, NJM4558 lineage)
tagline: Low-noise NJM4558 derivative with twice the output current. The DD rank is noise-screened for RIAA use, and one Japanese listener praised its clear treble.
technology: Bipolar dual op-amp built on New JRC's planar epitaxial process. It is an NJM4558 derivative with improved input and output stages, giving lower noise, about 2x the output current (25 mA), 6 V/us slew rate and 14 MHz unity-gain bandwidth. Marketed as a 'Low-noise dual pre-amplifier'.

part_numbers.notes: Base type. The datasheet lists DIP8, DMP8 and SIP8 package outlines. Distributors list it as discontinued.
DIP8, standard (unscreened) grade. Distributor listings show it as discontinued. Stock may remain at brokers.

part_numbers.status: discontinued (retail stock still sold, e.g. Akizuki)
part_numbers.notes: DIP8, D-rank low-noise selected version, guaranteed VNI <= 1.4 uV (Rs=2.2 kOhm, RIAA). Same design as the NJM2043D, screened for noise. This is the version enthusiasts praise.
Unconfirmed. Seen only on a Jotrin broker listing. The package is unknown and it is not in the Ver.2003-03-17 package table as summarised.

lineage.period: unknown introduction (datasheet Ver.2003-03-17 is the latest dated version found) to 2021
lineage.notes: Designed as a low-noise version of the NJM4558, with improved input and output stages and about 2x the output current.

New JRC's 20 Dec 2018 EOL notice covers products hit by the termination of its 4-inch wafer line. One search summary said NJM2043 is on that list, but I could not see the list itself (medium/low confidence). Distributors now show the NJM2043D and NJM2043DD as discontinued.
New JRC became part of Nisshinbo Micro Devices. Distributors (Octopart, Master Electronics, TrustedParts) list the NJM2043D and NJM2043DD under Nisshinbo as discontinued.

key_specs.condition: 'high output current' feature; about 2x the NJM4558 according to Akizuki
Rs=2.2 kOhm, RIAA weighting; NJM2043DD selected parts only

reputation.summary: The praise comes mainly from one Japanese enthusiast listening comparison (C-Area @WIKI). It rated the NJM2043DD the most pleasing of the NJM4558-lineage op-amps tested, noting unusually clear treble for a 4558-type and a fairly flat balance that suited classical music. Akizuki markets it as a low-noise-selected, improved 4558. Other opinions differ: a Zigsow user review is titled 'コレジャナイ音質' ('not the sound I wanted').
sonic_descriptors: clear treble, unusual for a 4558-type (one reviewer)
relatively flat balance, suited to classical music (one reviewer)
typical_uses: Phono/RIAA and other pre-amplifier stages (the DD rank is noise-graded under RIAA conditions)
Tone-control and line stages in legacy Japanese audio gear
DIP8 op-amp rolling in DIY audio
caveats: The praise rests mostly on one hobbyist listening test; others disagree (Zigsow review)
Discontinued; buy from reputable stock (e.g. Akizuki) rather than anonymous marketplaces
The DD rank differs from the D only by noise screening, not by design

counterfeit_notes: No part-specific counterfeit reports were found. The part is discontinued (DIP8 NJM2043D/DD still circulate on eBay, Reverb and brokers), so relabelled 4558-type parts are a plausible risk. The DD low-noise rank uses the same die as the D and can only be checked by measuring noise, so a remarked D sold as DD would be undetectable by inspection. Prefer known retail stock such as Akizuki.
alternatives: NJM4558DD (same lineage, low-noise selected; still sold by Akizuki)

corrections: Channels changed from 0 to 2 for all part numbers (dual op-amp).
Statuses changed from 'unknown' to discontinued. Distributors list the NJM2043D and NJM2043DD as discontinued.
NJM2043DD is the D-rank low-noise selected DIP8 version (VNI <= 1.4 uV, Rs=2.2 kOhm, RIAA), not just a package code.
Added part numbers NJM2043D (DIP8), NJM2043M (DMP8) and NJM2043L (SIP8), plus NJM2043S (unconfirmed broker listing).
Filled in the technology, key specs, datasheet (NJM2043_E Ver.2003-03-17), lineage and alternatives, which were empty in the draft.
Named the manufacturers separately: New Japan Radio as originator, Nisshinbo Micro Devices as successor.
claims_confirmed: The English datasheet is 'NJM2043 LOW-NOISE DUAL PRE-AMPLIFIER', Ver.2003-03-17 (https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/294/NJM2043_E-218482.pdf)

It is a bipolar low-noise version of the NJM4558, with 6 V/us slew rate and 14 MHz unity-gain bandwidth, on New JRC's planar epitaxial process (https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/294/NJM2043_E-218482.pdf)
Operating voltage is +/-4 V to +/-22 V and output current is 25 mA (https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/294/NJM2043_E-218482.pdf)

NJM2043DD is the low-noise selected version, with VNI <= 1.4 uV (Rs=2.2 kOhm, RIAA); the NJM4558 input/output stages were improved and output current is about 2x (https://akizukidenshi.com/catalog/g/g102369/)

The NJM2043D and NJM2043DD are listed as discontinued under Nisshinbo Micro Devices (https://octopart.com/part/nisshinbo-micro-devices-inc/NJM2043DD, https://www.onlinecomponents.com/en/productdetail/nisshinbo-micro-devices-inc/njm2043d-11971622.html)

New JRC issued an EOL notice dated 2018-12-20 on terminating its 4-inch wafer line (https://mm.digikey.com/Volume0/opasdata/d220001/medias/docus/739/181220_EOL.pdf). Whether NJM2043 is on its list was not directly confirmed.
The C-Area @WIKI review praises the NJM2043DD for clear treble and a flat balance suited to classical music (https://w.atwiki.jp/higemouse/pages/50.html)
A dissenting Zigsow user review exists, titled 'コレジャナイ音質' (https://zigsow.jp/item/326108/review/325414)

revision_chain_notes:
New JRC / Nisshinbo NJM2043 English datasheet (NJM2043_E). The only confirmed dated link in the chain is still Ver.2003-03-17. Two copies now confirm it: the known Mouser /datasheet/2/294/NJM2043_E-218482.pdf and a new Marutsu copy (marutsu.co.jp/.../NJM2043D.pdf), whose title shows 'Ver.2003-03-17'. No newer Nisshinbo re-issue has been found. No second-source vendor has been found either. The part appears to be JRC-only.

Missing links:
(1) Any edition before 2003, such as JRC databook or early datasheet editions from the NJM4558-derivative introduction era. Candidate copies that might hold one are the ICminer-scanned NJM2043S.pdf on Jotrin, alldatasheet entries 7233/7234 (low IDs suggest early uploads), datasheetarchive scans, and the datasheetq HTML page render (doc 533297). None shows a revision in the search summaries.
(2) The Japanese-language edition (NJM2043_J) and its Ver. date. It was not found.
(3) Any later NJR/Nisshinbo revision after 2003-03-17, for example one adding a DMP8/SIP8 package change or the NJM2043DD part number. It was not found. The old Mouser path /ds/2/294/njr_njm2043_e-547181.pdf could be a later upload, but its revision is not shown.
(4) The official NJR-hosted PDF URL and its Wayback captures. The product page https://www.njr.com/semicon/products/NJM2043.html is added as an archive seed.

No change log is available for any revision.
